@Component({

  standalone: true,

    NotFoundComponent,

  templateUrl: './references-classes.component.html',

export class ReferencesClassesLandingPageComponent{

  constructor(
    private route: ActivatedRoute,

    this.route.paramMap.subscribe((params) => {
